Conditions for periods for regulations
16C and 16D
Conditions for 175 day period
(1)
For the purposes of paragraphs 16C(3)(a) and (b) and 16D(3)(a) and (b), the conditions are the following:
(a)
the evaluation relates to a medicine (the
evaluation medicine
) that is the same as a medicine (an
acceptable foreign approved medicine
) that has been approved by a competent regulatory authority, of a foreign country or foreign jurisdiction determined under subregulation
(3), for general marketing in that country or jurisdiction;
(c)
the indications of the evaluation medicine are equivalent to the indications of the acceptable foreign approved medicine;
(d)
the strength, dosage form, formulation and directions for use of the evaluation medicine are identical to those of the acceptable foreign approved medicine;
(e)
the manufacturer and manufacturing process for the evaluation medicine are identical to those for the acceptable foreign approved medicine;
(f)
an application for marketing approval for the evaluation medicine has not been delayed, deferred, rejected, refused or withdrawn in any country;
(g)
if the evaluation medicine is a generic product in comparison to a registered medicine:
(i)
the indications of the evaluation medicine are identical to the indications of the registered medicine; and
(ii)
the reference product used by the competent regulatory authority mentioned in paragraph
(a) to assess the bioequivalence of the acceptable foreign approved medicine (in assessing the application for the approval for the acceptable foreign approved medicine) is identical to the registered medicine;
(h)
if the evaluation medicine is a biosimilar in relation to a registered medicine—the reference product used by the competent regulatory authority mentioned in paragraph
(a) (in assessing the application for the approval for the acceptable foreign approved medicine) is identical to the registered medicine;
(i)
the applicant in relation to the evaluation has given the Secretary the assessment, by the competent regulatory authority mentioned in paragraph
(a), of the application for the approval for the acceptable foreign approved medicine;
(j)
the assessment mentioned in paragraph
(i):
(i)
is complete and unredacted; and
(ii)
is in English; and
(iii)
includes comprehensive details of studies assessed in connection with the application for the approval for the acceptable foreign approved medicine; and
(iv)
includes copies of any correspondence relating to the application for the approval for the acceptable foreign approved medicine between the competent regulatory authority and the applicant for the approval; and
(v)
includes the competent regulatory authority’s final decision; and
(vi)
includes any certifications or authentications of reports relating to the approval; and
(vii)
is not, wholly or in part, based on (including compiled by reference to or in reliance on) any other assessment or evaluation (however described).
Conditions for 120 day period
(2)
For the purposes of paragraphs 16C(3)(a) and (b) and 16D(3)(a) and (b), the conditions are the following:
(aa)
the approval for the acceptable foreign approved medicine:
(i)
is in force; and
(ii)
was given not more than 12 months before the date of the application in relation to the evaluation;
(a)
the manufacturing site at which manufacturing steps other than labelling and release for supply are carried out for the evaluation medicine is identical to that for the acceptable foreign approved medicine;
(b)
if the evaluation medicine is manufactured in Australia—there is evidence that the medicine has been manufactured in accordance with Part
3
‑
3 of the Act;
(c)
if a step in the manufacture of the evaluation medicine has been carried out outside Australia—there is evidence that the manufacturing and quality control procedures used in the manufacture of the medicine are acceptable;
(d)
no additional information is required to complete the evaluation, other than:
(i)
the label and product information for the evaluation medicine; and
(ii)
the risk management plan (if any) for the evaluation medicine.
Determining foreign countries or foreign jurisdictions
(3)
The Secretary may, in writing published on the Therapeutic Goods Administration website, determine a foreign country or a foreign jurisdiction for the purposes of this regulation.

supplemental_reviewed_clauses.research_interpretation: Official national statute. Scope: Temporary shortage-related import or supply approvals; distinct from normal registration. Foreign approval can support temporary import or supply where substitutes are unavailable or in short supply and public-health conditions are met. Nonlisted reference countries can also qualify under additional manufacturing and availability conditions. This is a shortage route, not general new-drug recognition.

standard_drug_legal_comparison.version_note: Therapeutic Goods Regulations compilation 1 July 2024, regulations 16 C and 16 DA. 120- and 175-working-day evaluations are separate routes; the fixed 18-month approval fails the 12-month condition of the 120-day route.

new_active_substance.finding: Not resolved by reviewed source and context; no inference from silence.

named_reference_agencies.finding: Not resolved by reviewed source and context; no inference from silence.

prior_approval_count.finding: One qualifying foreign evaluation can support 16 DA(1); accepted country determination under 16 DA(3) must still be established.

standalone_review.finding: Foreign decision cannot have been made on another foreign authority's assessment.

approval_age.finding: 120-day evaluation requires foreign approval within preceding 12 months; fixed 18 months fails. This does not automatically bar the separate 175-day evaluation.

foreign_marketing.finding: Not resolved by reviewed source and context; no inference from silence.

same_product_dossier_site.finding: Equivalent indication and identical strength, formulation, directions, manufacturing process and manufacturer; more stringent site equivalence for 120-day route.

report_completeness.finding: Complete unredacted English foreign assessment, comprehensive study reports, all regulator correspondence and final decision required under 16 DA(1).

nonpublic_reports.finding: Unredacted assessment and regulator correspondence exceed a public approval summary; the full-report package is explicit.

Conditions for 175 day period
(1)
For the purposes of paragraphs 16C(3)(a) and (b) and 16D(3)(a) and (b), the conditions are the following:
(a)
the evaluation relates to a medicine (the
evaluation medicine
) that is the same as a medicine (an
acceptable foreign approved medicine
) that has been approved by a competent regulatory authority, of a foreign country or foreign jurisdiction determined under subregulation
(3), for general marketing in that country or jurisdiction;
(c)
the indications of the evaluation medicine are equivalent to the indications of the acceptable foreign approved medicine;
(d)
the strength, dosage form, formulation and directions for use of the evaluation medicine are identical to those of the acceptable foreign approved medicine;
(e)
the manufacturer and manufacturing process for the evaluation medicine are identical to those for the acceptable foreign approved medicine;
(f)
an application for marketing approval for the evaluation medicine has not been delayed, deferred, rejected, refused or withdrawn in any country;
(g)
if the evaluation medicine is a generic product in comparison to a registered medicine:
(i)
the indications of the evaluation medicine are identical to the indications of the registered medicine; and
(ii)
the reference product used by the competent regulatory authority mentioned in paragraph
(a) to assess the bioequivalence of the acceptable foreign approved medicine (in assessing the application for the approval for the acceptable foreign approved medicine) is identical to the registered medicine;
(h)
if the evaluation medicine is a biosimilar in relation to a registered medicine—the reference product used by the competent regulatory authority mentioned in paragraph
(a) (in assessing the application for the approval for the acceptable foreign approved medicine) is identical to the registered medicine;
(i)
the applicant in relation to the evaluation has given the Secretary the assessment, by the competent regulatory authority mentioned in paragraph
(a), of the application for the approval for the acceptable foreign approved medicine;
(j)
the assessment mentioned in paragraph
(i):
(i)
is complete and unredacted; and
(ii)
is in English; and
(iii)
includes comprehensive details of studies assessed in connection with the application for the approval for the acceptable foreign approved medicine; and
(iv)
includes copies of any correspondence relating to the application for the approval for the acceptable foreign approved medicine between the competent regulatory authority and the applicant for the approval; and
(v)
includes the competent regulatory authority’s final decision; and
(vi)
includes any certifications or authentications of reports relating to the approval; and
(vii)
is not, wholly or in part, based on (including compiled by reference to or in reliance on) any other assessment or evaluation (however described).

(2)

(aa)
the approval for the acceptable foreign approved medicine:

is in force; and
(ii)
was given not more than 12 months before the date of the application in relation to the evaluation;
(a)
the manufacturing site at which manufacturing steps other than labelling and release for supply are carried out for the evaluation medicine is identical to that for the acceptable foreign approved medicine;
(b)
if the evaluation medicine is manufactured in Australia—there is evidence that the medicine has been manufactured in accordance with Part

if a step in the manufacture of the evaluation medicine has been carried out outside Australia—there is evidence that the manufacturing and quality control procedures used in the manufacture of the medicine are acceptable;

the risk management plan (if any) for the evaluation medicine.

review_details.pathway: Foreign assessment with conditional 120/175-day evaluation clocks
review_details.document_title: Therapeutic Goods Regulations1990 consolidated2024 territory scope
review_details.version_scope_note: Therapeutic Goods Regulations compilation 1 July 2024, regulations 16 C and 16 DA. 120- and 175-working-day evaluations are separate routes; the fixed 18-month approval fails the 12-month condition of the 120-day route.
review_details.contextual_review_status: Targeted contextual review complete for recorded sections; full eligibility unresolved where stated.

new_active_substance.finding: Not resolved by reviewed source and context; no inference from silence.

named_reference_agencies.finding: Not resolved by reviewed source and context; no inference from silence.

prior_approval_count.finding: One qualifying foreign evaluation can support 16 DA(1); accepted country determination under 16 DA(3) must still be established.

standalone_review.finding: Foreign decision cannot have been made on another foreign authority's assessment.

approval_age.finding: 120-day evaluation requires foreign approval within preceding 12 months; fixed 18 months fails. This does not automatically bar the separate 175-day evaluation.

foreign_marketing.finding: Not resolved by reviewed source and context; no inference from silence.

same_product_dossier_site.finding: Equivalent indication and identical strength, formulation, directions, manufacturing process and manufacturer; more stringent site equivalence for 120-day route.

report_completeness.finding: Complete unredacted English foreign assessment, comprehensive study reports, all regulator correspondence and final decision required under 16 DA(1).

nonpublic_reports.finding: Unredacted assessment and regulator correspondence exceed a public approval summary; the full-report package is explicit.

accepted_redactions.finding: Not resolved by reviewed source and context; no inference from silence.

public_report_sufficiency.finding: Public assessment material alone fails the complete unredacted assessment/correspondence requirement.

applicant_consent.finding: Not resolved by reviewed source and context; no inference from silence.

reference_authority_permission.finding: Not resolved by reviewed source and context; no inference from silence.

regulator_to_regulator_sharing.finding: Not resolved by reviewed source and context; no inference from silence.

local_clinical_evidence.finding: Not resolved by reviewed source and context; no inference from silence.

quality_gmp.finding: Not resolved by reviewed source and context; no inference from silence.

scientific_assessment_retained.finding: An evaluation remains required; regulation changes evaluation period rather than automatically granting registration.

local_representative.finding: Not resolved by reviewed source and context; no inference from silence.

filing_fee.finding: Not resolved by reviewed source and context; no inference from silence.

translation_legalization.finding: Not resolved by reviewed source and context; no inference from silence.

cpp.finding: Not resolved by reviewed source and context; no inference from silence.

clock.finding: 40 working days preliminary assessment; 120/175/255 working-day evaluation alternatives. Calendar and active-review time are not inferred.

domestic_discretion.finding: No adverse foreign application history and all other statutory conditions remain to be verified.

A.finding: Public reports alone fail 16 DA complete unredacted report/correspondence package; ordinary route is separate.
unresolved_conditions: Other source-incorporated and administrative conditions; absence is not waiver.

B.finding: Full reports satisfy the documentary report condition of 175-day route, subject to accepted-country determination, adverse regulatory history and other requirements. 120-day route fails the 18-month fixed age.
unresolved_conditions: Other source-incorporated and administrative conditions; absence is not waiver.

C.eligibility: condition established but full eligibility unresolved
C.finding: Full eligibility is not established by the selected permission clause. Incorporated requirements, local conditions and administrative evidence remain unresolved.
unresolved_conditions: Other source-incorporated and administrative conditions; absence is not waiver.

D.eligibility: condition established but full eligibility unresolved
D.finding: Full eligibility is not established by the selected permission clause. Incorporated requirements, local conditions and administrative evidence remain unresolved.
unresolved_conditions: Other source-incorporated and administrative conditions; absence is not waiver.

E.eligibility: condition established but full eligibility unresolved
E.finding: One qualifying foreign assessment can suffice for 175-day evaluation; FDA recognition under the incorporated country determination remains to be established from this source version.
unresolved_conditions: Other source-incorporated and administrative conditions; absence is not waiver.

shared_authorization_effect.finding: Do not infer market inaccessibility from absence of a usable reference for the selected route.

paired_comparisons.B_vs_A: Explicit report-content gate for 16 DA; not a causal delay estimate.
paired_comparisons.approval_age: 18 months blocks 120-day route, not necessarily 175-day route.
paired_comparisons.interpretation: Condition-level legal comparison only; not an observed approval, causal time saving, cost or price estimate.

evidence.research_interpretation: 120 and 175 working days concern evaluation under stated conditions; the general clock is 255. The 12-month prior-approval condition is for the 120-day route. No automatic initial approval on missing this clock is inferred from variation-only section 16F.
